description.value: The Narrow Lounge is an intimate, dimly lit bar and lounge at 1898 Main Street in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, part of The Narrow Group's collection of restaurants and art spaces. It serves creative house cocktails and wine alongside Mexican-inspired fast food from its in-house Taco Kat menu, with a covered summer patio offering a livelier outdoor alternative. The venue has a reputation for a lively, unpretentious atmosphere and a devoted local following.
